title: TileLink TL-UL agent: a 64-word memory on the A and D channels, PutFullData, PutPartialData and Get with source echo, a request accepted in the clock its response leaves

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a request was answered with d_error: an opcode other than PutFullData / PutPartialData / Get, a size other than 4 bytes, a misaligned or out-of-range address (0x100 and up), a mask not matching the opcode, or a non-zero param; the core holds this until reset, so the bit cannot be cleared before then

notes: The A channel (a_valid ... a_data) and D channel (d_valid ... d_error) pins are the TL-UL agent pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the agent's error event.
One response is held at a time; a new request is accepted in the clock the held response is taken. TL-C (B, C and E channels) is not implemented. d_opcode bits 2:1 are always 0 (waived).
